title: Other Ways to Say "Congratulations" #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "Congratulations" in English – 5 natural phrases.
Don't say "Congratulations". Say this instead:
• Well done! (for good work)
• Congrats! (casual)
• Way to go! (casual, American)
• I'm so happy for you! (warm)
• You deserve it. (after hard work)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
